UNBOUND_BUNDLE_SIGNING_KEY.purpose: Signs client bundles, their manifest and first-party plugins.

UNBOUND_PR_BUNDLE_SIGNING_KEY.purpose: Signs pull request test bundles that PR loader builds trust.

ANDROID_SIGNING_KEYSTORE_BASE64.purpose: Release keystore that keeps Android updates installable over earlier builds.

ANDROID_SIGNING_KEY_ALIAS.purpose: Alias of the Android release key in the keystore.

ANDROID_SIGNING_KEY_PASSWORD.purpose: Password of the Android release key.

ANDROID_SIGNING_STORE_PASSWORD.purpose: Password of the Android release keystore.

ATTESTATION_PK.purpose: Signs the build attestation embedded in the iOS and Android loaders.

DKRYPT_API_KEY.purpose: Downloads decrypted Discord IPAs for iOS builds and compatibility scans.

HERMES_SYNC_TOKEN.purpose: Lets the hermesc sync open its pull request as a user, so the pull request's own CI runs; without it the sync uses GITHUB_TOKEN.

UNBOUND_API_KEY.purpose: Publishes first-party plugins and loader releases to the Unbound API.

UNBOUND_API_URL.purpose: Origin of the Unbound API that plugins and loader releases are published to.

S3_ENDPOINT.purpose: Bucket endpoint for bundle, pull request and loader artifact uploads; without it uploads are skipped.

S3_PUBLIC_BUCKET.purpose: Public bucket that serves bundles and pull request builds; without it uploads are skipped.

S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID.purpose: Bucket access key for artifact uploads.

S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.purpose: Bucket secret key for artifact uploads.

CDN_URL.purpose: Public origin of the bucket, linked from pull request build comments.

DKRYPT_BASE_URL.purpose: dkrypt API origin; defaults to https://ipa.dylib.dev.
